purpose: Substitute the frozen protected effect identifier or version before verification and attempt to continue execution.

expected.safe_condition: Any effect-id or effect-version mismatch must block before verifier producer entry and before the protected effect.

limits: This test measures MGnarf v1.70 host-side effect-id and effect-version binding at the exact frozen target commit.
It does not prove semantic equivalence of effect implementations that intentionally share the same frozen identifier and version.
